what_it_does: Multiplies the input by an oscillator, creating sum-and-difference sidebands around the source frequencies.
audible_or_output_result: Produces inharmonic, bell-like or tremolo-like spectra depending on modulation frequency; optional Drive adds distortion.

what_it_does: Generates a cluster of oscillators distributed around a center frequency with controllable spacing and random pitch motion.
audible_or_output_result: Produces chorused, clustered and increasingly inharmonic tones; spacing opens the chord while motion animates individual pitches.

what_it_does: Changes the pitch of incoming audio by resampling/windowed time-domain processing while preserving overall signal flow.
audible_or_output_result: Transposes the source up or down; Window trades temporal clarity against pitch-shift texture and Wide creates stereo separation.

what_it_does: Creates a large algorithmic hall with controllable decay, room shape, modulation, damping and low-frequency decay behavior.
audible_or_output_result: Produces deep, diffuse ambience; damping and bass controls let the tail become darker, heavier or more separated from the source.
key_controls: Mix, Mod Depth, Decay, Size, Damping, Freeze

what_it_does: A complete polyphonic synthesizer voice based on Ableton Live Drift; it generates audio rather than processing an incoming audio signal.
audible_or_output_result: Produces subtractive-synthesis tones with oscillator variation, filtering, envelopes, modulation, unison and controlled pitch drift.
key_controls: Voicemode, Voices, Legato, Unison, Stereospread, Glidetime

what_it_does: Restricts peaks to a defined output ceiling using fast gain reduction and look-ahead behavior.
audible_or_output_result: Prevents signal peaks from exceeding the ceiling and can increase apparent loudness when driven harder into gain reduction.
key_controls: Gain, Threshold, Release, Link, Ceiling, Routing

what_it_does: Generates a smoothly changing semi-random modulation signal rather than processing audio.
audible_or_output_result: Creates evolving control motion that does not repeat like a conventional LFO; Step and Morph govern the pace and continuity of the wandering trajectory.
key_controls: Frequency, Morph, Step, Transform 2, Transform 1, Transform 2 Type

what_it_does: Reduces gain when the input exceeds a threshold, narrowing dynamic range according to ratio, attack and release.
audible_or_output_result: Loud peaks are restrained and level becomes more consistent; attack/release determine how much transient shape and pumping remain.

what_it_does: Creates an algorithmic reverb whose low- and high-frequency decay times can be scaled independently around a crossover.
audible_or_output_result: Produces a spacious tail with unusually direct spectral-decay control, allowing lows and highs to persist for different lengths.
key_controls: Mix, Decay, Size, Freeze, Crossover, Low Decay Mult

what_it_does: Creates independently timed stereo echoes with feedback, filtering, modulation and optional ping-pong routing.
audible_or_output_result: Produces discrete repeats, stereo motion, comb-like coloration at short times, or continuously evolving echoes with feedback.
key_controls: Mix, Delay Time, Feedback, Delay Mod, Mod Rate, Modfilter

what_it_does: Feeds a pitch-shifted component back into an algorithmic reverb tail.
audible_or_output_result: Adds rising, luminous pitched energy above the reverberation; Shimmer/Pitch Shift determine how strongly the tail blooms into upper harmonics.
key_controls: Mix, Mod Depth, Decay, Size, Damping, Diffusion

what_it_does: Shapes the spectrum with low and high shelving bands plus a sweepable mid-frequency peak band.
audible_or_output_result: Use it for broad tonal balance: add or remove weight, presence and brightness without changing timing or pitch.
key_controls: Mid Gain, High Gain, Mid Frequency, Low Gain

what_it_does: Creates a dense algorithmic reverb with diffusion, modulation, damping and distance controls.
audible_or_output_result: Ranges from sparse reflective ambience to smooth dense tails; modulation adds movement and damping progressively darkens the space.
key_controls: Mix, Mod Depth, Decay, Size, Damping, Diffusion

what_it_does: Provides multiple filter/resonator algorithms from Live Meld behind a common frequency plus two macro controls.
audible_or_output_result: Can move from conventional EQ/filtering to phasing, vowel filtering, comb filtering and physical resonances depending on Type.

what_it_does: Generates FM tones while morphing through a set of harmonic and subharmonic modulator ratios.
audible_or_output_result: Creates spectrally organized FM timbres that shift between subharmonic, harmonic and brighter sideband structures.

what_it_does: Mixes the input with very short modulated delays and feedback, producing moving comb-filter interference.
audible_or_output_result: Creates sweeping notches, metallic motion and jet-like coloration; feedback intensifies the comb resonance.

what_it_does: Generates a three-operator FM tone with two modulators feeding one carrier.
audible_or_output_result: Designed for focused FM bass/squelch sounds; modulation index and feedback move from clean fundamentals toward complex metallic spectra.

what_it_does: Performs gain, balance, phase, channel, mid/side, mono and bass-mono operations on a stereo signal.
audible_or_output_result: Changes level and stereo geometry without adding an intentional effect tail; useful for image control, phase correction and low-end mono compatibility.
key_controls: Gain, Balance, Channel Mode, Invert L, Invert R, Mono

what_it_does: Passes the input through a resonant digitally modeled analog low-pass filter with controllable pre-gain.
audible_or_output_result: Removes high frequencies while emphasizing the cutoff region; increased pre-gain drives the model for stronger nonlinear color.

what_it_does: Generates pulses probabilistically at a controllable rate and duration rather than processing incoming audio.
audible_or_output_result: Creates irregular gates/triggers for modulation; Chance controls event probability and Length controls pulse duration.
key_controls: Frequency, Chance, Length, Transform 2, Transform 1, Transform 2 Type

what_it_does: Mixes the input with short, slowly modulated delay voices to create small pitch/time differences between copies of the signal.
audible_or_output_result: Thickens and widens the source; deeper modulation and feedback increase pitch motion and metallic/comb coloration.
key_controls: Mix, Gain, Feedback, Rate, Mod Depth, Width

what_it_does: Applies an exponential response curve to a signal, remapping its amplitude trajectory rather than adding delay or resonance.
audible_or_output_result: Changes the curvature and sensitivity of a control/audio signal, emphasizing one part of its range while compressing another.

what_it_does: Creates short modulated delayed copies of the input and spreads them in stereo.
audible_or_output_result: Makes a single source sound wider and more layered, with detuned/animated doubling rather than clearly separated echoes.

what_it_does: Filters audio through a bank of resonant bands tuned to formant patterns associated with the vowels A, E, I, O and U.
audible_or_output_result: Imposes vocal/formant coloration on the source; Morph moves between vowel spectra and Resonance exaggerates the formant peaks.

what_it_does: Generates a plate-like reverberant field, creating pseudo-stereo ambience from the input.
audible_or_output_result: Adds a diffuse tail and sense of space; predelay separates the source from the tail while damping darkens the decay.

what_it_does: Generates a pseudo-random lo-fi square-wave tone reminiscent of data or old-computer tape loading.
audible_or_output_result: Produces unstable, stepped, digital timbres with intentionally coarse and noisy harmonic structure.

what_it_does: Generates a square wave that morphs toward a second square wave pitched a perfect fifth above.
audible_or_output_result: Blends fundamental and fifth-related energy while pulse width changes the harmonic balance.

what_it_does: Generates repeating ramp-shaped modulation rather than processing audio.
audible_or_output_result: Produces cyclic rising/falling control motion; Shape/Slope alter the contour and optional transforms reshape the output further.
key_controls: Frequency, Shape, Slope, Transform 2, Transform 1, Transform 2 Type

what_it_does: Generates a periodic tone that continuously morphs among sine, triangle, saw and pulse waveforms.
audible_or_output_result: Changes harmonic content as Shape moves through the waveform family; the waveform-specific effect adds folding, phase offset or pulse-width variation.

what_it_does: Synthesizes discrete resonant bubble-like events as an audio source rather than processing an input signal.
audible_or_output_result: Produces watery, popping tones whose event rate and randomness can move from sparse droplets to dense bubbling textures.

what_it_does: Passes the input through modulated all-pass stages that create moving spectral notches without using audible delay repeats.
audible_or_output_result: Produces swirling phase cancellation and resonant sweeps; center/spread place the notch field and feedback strengthens the effect.
key_controls: Mix, Feedback, Mod Depth, Center Frequency, Spread, Blend

what_it_does: Combines dual classic waveform oscillators with noise bursts, distortion and a sub-oscillator.
audible_or_output_result: Morphs from recognizable synth waves into rough, noisy and thicker composite timbres as the Rough amount increases.

what_it_does: Generates a carrier oscillator frequency-modulated by a second oscillator.
audible_or_output_result: Moves from a simple tone to complex sideband spectra as FM amount rises; Ratio controls harmonic versus inharmonic relationships.

what_it_does: Generates noise through a resonant band-pass filter.
audible_or_output_result: Creates pitched or airy noise bands; narrowing the bandwidth increases resonance and turns broadband noise into a more focused tone.

what_it_does: Generates randomly timed filtered transients as an audio source.
audible_or_output_result: Produces crackling, popping textures whose density and intensity range from sparse surface noise to busy granular activity.

what_it_does: Synthesizes a mixture of raindrop-like resonant events and wind/noise as an audio source.
audible_or_output_result: Moves from sparse droplets to dense rainfall; resonance makes individual drops more pitched and ringing.

what_it_does: Applies nonlinear A-law companding to compress or expand the signal amplitude.
audible_or_output_result: Changes low-level versus high-level detail and can create a distinctly encoded, nonlinear dynamic coloration at stronger settings.

what_it_does: Reduces temporal and amplitude resolution by lowering effective sample rate and bit depth, with optional jitter and shaping.
audible_or_output_result: Introduces quantization grain, aliasing, digital edge and intentionally lo-fi texture.

what_it_does: Builds multiple modulated delay voices around the input, with feedback, width and warmth processing.
audible_or_output_result: Creates a denser, wider chorus-like field than a simple chorus; warmth adds filtering/distortion and feedback increases resonance.
key_controls: Mix, Gain, Feedback, Rate, Mod Depth, Width

what_it_does: Generates two synchronized square-wave components around a common fundamental.
audible_or_output_result: Produces hard-edged pulse spectra with additional interval/beat structure from the two square-wave frequencies.

what_it_does: Retriggers a synthesized kick at the oscillator rate to create a continuous pitched tone.
audible_or_output_result: Produces aggressive granular/buzzing bass timbres whose base pitch and envelope amount alter the kick-derived texture.

what_it_does: Loops short windows of noise at audio rates to turn noise into a pitched granular-style oscillator.
audible_or_output_result: Creates rough tonal spectra; Rate changes how noise windows are replaced and Fade smooths transitions between them.

what_it_does: Applies a configurable nonlinear transfer curve to incoming audio, with drive, curve, damping, ripples and post-clipping control.
audible_or_output_result: Adds controllable harmonic distortion from subtle saturation to complex folded/rippled spectra; the transfer-function controls define the nonlinear color.
key_controls: Mix, Drive, Gain, Damping, Curve, Depth

what_it_does: Remaps an incoming control/audio signal using selectable operations such as offset, scaling, gating, skew, rectification, quantization or sample-and-hold.
audible_or_output_result: Changes the shape and range of a signal rather than its spectral content; Type selects the transformation and Macro controls its amount/behavior.

what_it_does: Generates an 8-bit-style square-wave tone with pulse-width and pitch-pattern modulation.
audible_or_output_result: Produces bright game-console timbres, pulse-width color and simple arpeggiated/pitched motion.

what_it_does: Combines saturation, compression, transient shaping and a tunable low-frequency resonant “boom” stage for drum material.
audible_or_output_result: Adds density and glue, sharpens or softens attacks, introduces harmonic grit and can reinforce the low end with a decaying resonance.
key_controls: Mix, Drive, Decay, Damping, Boom, Boom Frequency

what_it_does: Applies hard input clipping, resonant low-pass filtering and soft output saturation in a single nonlinear filter path.
audible_or_output_result: Combines cutoff/resonance shaping with added harmonics, so increasing Drive makes the filter progressively dirtier and more aggressive.

what_it_does: Analyzes the input spectrum and reinforces pitched spectral resonances and overtone structures around a chosen fundamental.
audible_or_output_result: Turns noisy or complex material into ringing, tuned and chord-like textures whose decay and harmonic spacing can be shaped.
key_controls: Mix, Frequency, Decay, Voices, Unison, Harmonics

what_it_does: Generates decreasing ramps whose onsets are distributed with a Euclidean rhythm algorithm.
audible_or_output_result: Produces evenly distributed rhythmic modulation patterns; Steps and Pulses determine the density and spacing of events.
key_controls: Frequency, Steps, Pulses, Transform 2, Transform 1, Transform 2 Type

what_it_does: Freezes and delays spectral frames, then shifts, sprays and feeds them back independently of the original time-domain signal.
audible_or_output_result: Produces suspended spectra, smeared echoes, frozen timbres and pitch-shifted spectral clouds.
key_controls: Mix, Feedback, Freeze, Spread, Fade In, Crossfade Pct

what_it_does: Generates layered octave components that continuously rise or fall while maintaining the illusion of an endlessly moving pitch.
audible_or_output_result: Creates perpetual ascent/descent gestures; Rate controls direction/speed and Width controls the octave span.

what_it_does: Generates sparse random impulses distributed in time as an audio source.
audible_or_output_result: Produces impulse textures from isolated clicks to dense noise-like excitation; Spacing controls how far apart the impulses occur.

what_it_does: Applies continuously modulated short delay to vary the apparent pitch of the incoming signal.
audible_or_output_result: Creates periodic pitch wobble without a dry copy; Rate and Mod set speed/depth while shaping and offset alter the modulation contour/stereo relation.
key_controls: Gain, Rate, Mod Depth, Offset, Shaping

what_it_does: Uses a reference/envelope relationship to reshape the attack and sustain portions of an audio signal.
audible_or_output_result: Can emphasize or soften onset impact and alter the apparent sustain/body without conventional threshold-based compression.

what_it_does: Applies heavy fuzz-style nonlinear clipping with bass, mid and treble tone shaping.
audible_or_output_result: Produces dense, compressed harmonic distortion with a rougher edge than overdrive; EQ controls shape the resulting fuzz spectrum.
key_controls: Mix, Gain, Sub, Mid Frequency, Mid, Bass

what_it_does: Filters incoming audio with resonant filter models that can be animated by envelope, LFO and sidechain-derived modulation.
audible_or_output_result: Creates moving spectral emphasis, sweeps and resonant coloration that can follow the dynamics of the source.
key_controls: Frequency, Filter Type, Resonance, Drive, Envelope Amount, Internalscgain

what_it_does: Runs the signal through two flexible delay lines with feedback plus filter, envelope, modulation, noise and character controls.
audible_or_output_result: Produces stereo or ping-pong echoes ranging from clean repeats to tape-like pitch movement, diffusion, wobble and degraded feedback textures.
key_controls: Mix, Delay Time, Feedback, Repitch Smoothing Time, Mod Delay, Mod Envelope

what_it_does: A monophonic sample-playback instrument with pitch, envelopes, filtering, modulation, noise/sub layers and internal effects.
audible_or_output_result: Transforms a loaded sample into a playable drum voice, from clean one-shots to heavily reshaped, layered and modulated percussion.
key_controls: Filter Type, Cutoff, Gain, Attack, Decay, Length

what_it_does: Routes audio through up to three saturation/shaping stages with filtering, feedback, compression and flexible modulation.
audible_or_output_result: Adds harmonics, clipping, density and animated nonlinear color, ranging from subtle warmth to aggressive multi-stage distortion.
key_controls: Blend, Input Gain, Routing, Tone Amount, Tone Frequency, Shaper Amount 1

what_it_does: Applies pedal-style nonlinear distortion followed by bass, mid and treble tone shaping.
audible_or_output_result: Adds clipped harmonics and sustain; the tone controls redistribute the distorted energy across the spectrum.
key_controls: Mix, Gain, Sub, Mid Frequency, Mid, Bass

what_it_does: Generates a control-rate/audio-rate signal that alternates between two levels rather than processing audio.
audible_or_output_result: Useful as a repeating two-state modulation source; its transitions can be further transformed before controlling another parameter.
key_controls: Frequency, Level 1, Level 2, Transform 2, Transform 1, Transform 2 Type

what_it_does: Combines frequency modulation, waveshaping and wavefolding in a single oscillator.
audible_or_output_result: Produces harmonically rich tones that can move from relatively pure FM to dense folded, buzzy spectra.

what_it_does: Applies overdrive-style nonlinear distortion followed by bass, mid and treble tone shaping.
audible_or_output_result: Adds harmonics and level-dependent grit while retaining more source contour than hard fuzz; tone controls sculpt the distorted spectrum.
key_controls: Mix, Gain, Sub, Mid Frequency, Mid, Bass

what_it_does: Applies selectable waveshaping/clipping curves with input drive, output gain and optional post clipping.
audible_or_output_result: Adds harmonics, density and controlled clipping; curve choice determines whether the result is soft, hard, folded or digitally clipped.
key_controls: Mix, Drive, Gain, Curve, DC Block, Post Clip

what_it_does: Excites a bank of resonant modes modeled as a plate or membrane, imposing pitched resonances on the input.
audible_or_output_result: Turns impulses, noise and other signals into ringing physical-model tones; frequency, decay, damping and geometry control the resonance.
key_controls: Frequency, Ratio, Decay, Damping, Resonator Type

what_it_does: Analyzes an incoming audio signal and estimates its fundamental frequency.
audible_or_output_result: Outputs pitch/frequency information for tracking or control; it is an analyzer and does not intentionally alter the source audio.

what_it_does: Creates an algorithmic reverb whose tail is continuously modulated by morphable stereo waveforms.
audible_or_output_result: Adds animated, chorused movement to the space; Tides and waveform/rate controls can make the decay gently breathe or strongly undulate.
key_controls: Mix, Rate, Decay, Size, Damping, Freeze

what_it_does: Generates a modulation signal whose waveform can morph and fold, with optional post-transform stages.
audible_or_output_result: Provides cyclic control motion rather than an audio effect; Shape/Fold define the contour and FX transforms remap the resulting modulation.
key_controls: Frequency, Shape, Fold, Transform 2, Transform 1, Transform 2 Type

what_it_does: Generates paired left/right LFO signals with controllable phase, duty, waveform and independent spin behavior.
audible_or_output_result: Creates stereo modulation trajectories; phase offsets move channels apart while Spin lets their rates diverge.
key_controls: Frequency, Waveform, Phase, Stereo Phase, Spin, Duty

what_it_does: Generates an 808-style kick/bass voice with a decaying pitch sweep and controllable tonal aggression.
audible_or_output_result: Produces low, punchy synthesized bass drums or sustained bass tones; Decay shapes the pitch fall and Tone increases resonance/drive/noise character.

what_it_does: Generates a shaped main oscillator plus an auxiliary oscillator one octave below.
audible_or_output_result: Adds low-frequency weight beneath the main tone; Tone reshapes the main waveform and Aux controls the octave-down component.

what_it_does: Provides the oscillator family used in Live Meld behind a common frequency plus two context-sensitive macro controls.
audible_or_output_result: Selects among classic, FM, noise, chiptune, swarm, rain, Shepard and other oscillator models while the macros reshape each model.

what_it_does: Measures the amplitude contour of an incoming signal and outputs a smoothed control signal rather than an audio effect.
audible_or_output_result: Turns loudness changes into modulation data; attack and release determine how quickly the output follows rising and falling energy.

what_it_does: Generates two basic-shape oscillators and blends/detunes them as a single sound source.
audible_or_output_result: Produces thicker classic waveforms; detuning introduces beating and width while Shape changes harmonic profile.
